name: garmin-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your Garmin training, sleep and recovery. Uses Garmin's official Personal API: no password, read-only.
long_description: Ask Claude about your training, sleep and recovery, using your own Garmin data. It gives Claude read-only access to your Garmin Connect data through Garmin's official Personal API, using an API key you can revoke at any time instead of your Garmin password, and data goes straight from Garmin to your computer. To get a key, open Garmin Connect > Settings > Personal API Token and create one. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin; "Garmin" and "Garmin Connect" are trademarks of Garmin Ltd. or its subsidiaries.

garmin_api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
garmin_api_key.description: Create one in Garmin Connect > Settings > Personal API Token. Pick 1 year.

update_check.title: Check for updates
update_check.description: Let Claude tell you when a new version is out.

tools.name: get_readiness
tools.description: Best first call for 'how recovered am I', 'should I train hard today', 'how did I sleep last night'.

tools.name: summarize_wellness
tools.description: Best tool for wellness trends over weeks or months ('has my sleep improved', 'resting HR trend this year', 'stress lately').

tools.name: get_daily_summaries
tools.description: One flat row per day: steps, distance, floors, calories, resting/min/max HR, intensity minutes, stress, Body Battery, respiration, SpO2, hydration.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: User profile settings (units, measurement system, birth year, etc.) and heart-rate zones.

tools.name: get_sleep_summaries
tools.description: Night-by-night sleep over a range, one compact row per night filed under the date the user woke up.

tools.name: get_sleep
tools.description: One night's sleep, same compact shape as get_sleep_summaries.

tools.name: get_hrv_summaries
tools.description: Daily heart rate variability over a range: overnight average, 5-minute high, 7-day average, baseline band, status.

tools.name: get_hrv
tools.description: HRV summary plus individual readings for one night.

tools.name: get_body_battery
tools.description: Daily Body Battery (Garmin's 0-100 energy estimate) over a range, one compact row per day.

tools.name: get_stress
tools.description: Day-by-day all-day stress over a range, one row per day as Garmin returns it.

tools.name: get_heart_rate
tools.description: Heart rate for one day: resting, min, max, 7-day resting average, and hourly min/avg/max in local time.

tools.name: get_steps
tools.description: Day-by-day steps over a range, one row per day as Garmin returns it.

tools.name: get_wellness_activity_summaries
tools.description: Garmin's wellness activity summaries over a range: all-day movement records kept apart from recorded workouts.

tools.name: get_spo2
tools.description: SpO2 for one day: average, lowest, sleep average, 7-day average and hourly averages.

tools.name: get_fitness_age
tools.description: Garmin's fitness age as of a date, plus the components behind it.

tools.name: get_weight
tools.description: Weight and body composition measurements over a range, from a Garmin smart scale or entered manually in Garmin Connect.

tools.name: get_hydration
tools.description: Water intake the user logged in Garmin Connect, day by day over a range.

tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: List individual recorded activities (runs, rides, swims, strength, etc.) with the activity_id needed for get_activity and get_activity_analysis.

tools.name: summarize_activities
tools.description: Best tool for activity totals and trends (e.g. 'how far did I run each month', 'has my pace improved').

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: One activity in detail: distance, times, pace, speed, HR, cadence, running dynamics, power, training effect and load, temperature, RPE/feel and split summaries.

tools.name: compare_activities
tools.description: Side-by-side compact detail for 2-5 activities (same fields as get_activity), fetched in parallel.

tools.name: get_activity_workouts
tools.description: The planned workout linked to one recorded activity, if any.

tools.name: get_personal_bests
tools.description: Fastest 1 km to marathon across your activities, with the next two best efforts and Riegel race estimates; computed from your activity files, not Garmin's official records.

tools.name: analyze_recovery_impact
tools.description: Whether sleep, HRV or Body Battery relate to how you run: runs after your best third of nights vs your worst third, compared at the same heart rate.

tools.name: get_activity_analysis
tools.description: Per-km or per-mile splits, the watch's laps / workout reps, best efforts, time in HR zones and first-vs-second-half drift for one recorded activity, computed from Garmin's original FIT file.

tools.name: get_nutrition
tools.description: Food log for one day: nutrition goals, calories and nutrients consumed, and per-meal breakdown.

tools.name: get_weight_goals
tools.description: The weight goal the user set in Garmin Connect that was in effect over a range, with its goal range.

tools.name: get_menstrual_cycle
tools.description: Menstrual cycle tracking as of one date: Garmin's cycle summary and day view.

prompts.name: readiness_check
prompts.description: Recovery check from last night's sleep, HRV, resting HR, Body Battery and recent training load.
prompts.text: Am I ready to train hard today? Call get_readiness once (date 'today'). Compare last night against my own recent averages, call out anything unusual in HRV, resting HR, sleep or training load, and finish with a one-line recommendation (hard / moderate / easy / rest) and why. Keep it short.

prompts.name: sleep_report
prompts.description: Sleep duration, stages, score and consistency over a period, with weekday patterns.
prompts.text: Give me a sleep report for this period: ${arguments.period}. Use the closest named period (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_30_days, last_90_days, last_180_days, last_365_days, this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year), or start_date/end_date if none fits. Call summarize_wellness with include ['sleep','hrv'] twice: group_by 'week' for the trend and group_by 'weekday' for patterns. Cover average duration vs need, deep/REM, sleep score, consistency, any weekday pattern, and two or three practical suggestions.

prompts.name: training_review
prompts.description: Volume, pace, intensity distribution and load trend for a sport over a period.
prompts.text: Review my training over this period: ${arguments.period}. Sport: ${arguments.activity_type}. Use the closest named period (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_30_days, last_90_days, last_180_days, last_365_days, this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year), or start_date/end_date if none fits. Call summarize_activities with group_by 'week', with activity_type set to that sport's Garmin type key (e.g. running, cycling), or no activity_type if the sport is 'all'. Cover volume and consistency, pace trend, time in HR zones (how much is easy vs hard), the load trend (weekly change and acute:chronic ratio), and the longest/fastest efforts. Use search_activities with sort_by only if you need to name a specific session.

prompts.name: weekly_checkin
prompts.description: This week vs last week: training, sleep, stress and recovery.
prompts.text: Give me a weekly check-in. Call summarize_activities with period 'last_28_days' and group_by 'week', and summarize_wellness with period 'last_28_days' and group_by 'week'. Compare the latest week with the previous ones: training volume and load, sleep, resting HR, HRV, stress. Highlight what improved, what slipped, and one focus for next week.

prompts.name: compare_recent
prompts.description: Side-by-side comparison of my most recent sessions of one type.
prompts.text: Compare my most recent sessions of this sport: ${arguments.activity_type}. Call search_activities with activity_type set to that sport's Garmin type key (e.g. running) and limit 5, then compare_activities on the ones of similar distance. Show pace, HR, cadence and training effect side by side and say what changed.
